title: Why Hurricane Names Keep Getting Banned For Good
hook: Nobody will ever name a storm Katrina again, after 100 retired names.
closing: Twenty major disasters a year. The list only grows.
question: Whose name should be retired next? Tell me.

segments.say: By 1954, one name was retired. By 2024, 100 were banned for good.
It's not wind speed. A name goes when reusing it would feel wrong; Katrina alone cost about $125 billion.
Crowded coasts and warmer oceans mean the US now averages over 20 major disasters a year, several times the 1980s rate.
